title: Endothelial cells differentiation from hPSCs
protocol: Reconstitute N2B27 Medium by mixing 500ml DMEM/F12 medium with 500ml Neurobasal medium.
Add 20ml B27 (1.94%) and 10ml N2 (0.97%) to the mixture.
Mix in 1ml β-Mercaptoethanol (0.097%).
Sterile filter the mixture using a 0.22 μm filter.
Store the filtered medium at 4°C for up to 1 month.
Prepare StemPro-34 Medium by mixing 500ml StemPro-34 medium with 5ml Pen/Strep (1:100).
Add 5ml Glutamax (1:100) and StemPro-34 Supplement to the mixture.
Store the prepared medium at 4°C for up to 1 month.
Resuspend 10mg of CHIR-99021 in 5ml DMSO.
Store the resuspended solution at -80°C or -20°C for a year.
Resuspend 2mg of CP21R in 630μl DMSO.
Store the resuspended solution at -80°C or -20°C for a year.
Resuspend 10ug of BMP4 in 4ml of 5-10mM citric acid pH 3.
Store the resuspended solution at -80°C or -20°C for a year.
Dissolve 100μg of VEGF165 in 1ml sterile water.
Store the dissolved solution at -80°C for a year.
Dissolve 10mg of forskolin in 2.436ml DMSO.
Pre-warm the solution for a few minutes in a water bath (37°C).
Store the pre-warmed solution at -20°C for a month.
Add 1 ml sterile H₂O to 1mg fibronectin and incubate at RT for 30min without shaking.
Add 39 ml PBS (without Ca and Mg) to achieve a fibronectin concentration of 25 µg/ml.
Add 6 ml of the fibronectin solution to one T75 flask, achieving a fibronectin coating of 2 μg/cm².
Incubate the T75 flask for one hour at RT.
Wash the T75 flask carefully without scraping the surface once with sterile water.
Coat one T175 with growth factor reduced matrigel by diluting it 1:30 on ice and thawing.
Incubate the plates at RT for 1h, then aspirate the matrigel and wash once with PBS.
Add 20 ml of pre-warmed mTeSR1 + ROCK-Inhibitor (final conc. 10 µM) to the T175 flask.
Aspirate growth medium from an 80% confluent 10 cm plate.
Wash with 10 ml pre-warmed PBS (Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺ free).
Add 3 ml pre-warmed Accutase and incubate for 3-7 min at 37°C.
Check cell detachment under a microscope.
Add 3 ml pre-warmed mTeSR1.
Transfer cells to a 15 ml Falcon tube.
Count cells.
Centrifuge the suspension at 1000 rpm (210g) for 5 min.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 10 ml pre-warmed mTeSR1 + ROCK-Inhibitor (final concentration 10 µM).
Seed the cells at a density of 37,000-47,000 hPSCs per cm².
Incubate the cells at 37°C with 5% CO₂ overnight.
Replace media with pre-warmed N2B27 Medium supplemented with 6-8 µM CHIR-99021 or 1 µM CP21 + 25 ng/ml hBMP4 for 3 days without medium change.
Replace media with StemPro-34 SFM medium supplemented with 200 ng/ml VEGF and 2 µM forskolin. Change the medium every day for two days.
Sort CD144-positive endothelial cells using magnetic separation (MACS).
Replate sorted CD144-positive cells on fibronectin-coated plates.
Aspirate medium and wash cells with pre-warmed PBS (Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺ free).
Add 5 ml pre-warmed Accutase.
Incubate for 3-5 min at 37°C.
Dissociate cells by gently pipetting up and down a few times to ensure single cell detachment.
Add 5 ml cold StemPro-34 Medium.
Transfer cells to a 50ml Falcon tube.
Count cells and calculate the volume of CD144 beads and MACS running buffer required for your sample (up to 1x10⁷ cells in 80 μl cold MACS running buffer + 20 μl CD144-microbeads).
Centrifuge at 1000 rpm (210g) for 5 min.
Aspirate supernatant.
Loosen cell pellet by gently flicking the tube and resuspend it in the appropriate amount of cold MACS-buffer and CD144-microbeads.
Incubate for 20 min at 4°C.
Remove the unbound beads by adding 5ml cold MACS running buffer and centrifuge at 210g for 5 min.
Aspirate supernatant, loosen cell pellet by gently flicking the tube.
Resuspend the pellet in 0.5 ml MACS running buffer.
Filter the cells using a 30μm pre-separation filter placed on a 15 ml Falcon tube.
Rinse filter with 0.5 ml cold MACS-Buffer to reduce cell loss.
Put the 15ml falcon in the first position of the autoMACSpro tube holder.
Add 2 other falcons in positions 2 and 3 for the depleted and eluted cell fractions.
Choose and run program “Posseld2” (about 8 min/sample).
After sorting, count the eluted cells and centrifuge at 210g for 5 min.
Aspirate supernatant, loosen cell pellet by gently flicking the tube and resuspend cells in pre-warmed StemPro34 + 50ng/ml VEGF.
Seed 2x10^6 cells in 20 ml StemPro34 + 50ng/ml VEGF on fibronectin coated plates or flasks (about 26000 cells/cm^2).
Keep 1x 105 cells as isotype control (IgG-Ab) for differentiation efficiency.
Keep 1x 105 cells as unstained control for differentiation efficiency.
Label 1x 105 cells with CD144-PE antibody for differentiation efficiency.
Label 1x 105 cells of the CD144 positive fraction with CD144-PE antibody for sorting efficiency.
Label 1x 105 cells of the CD144 negative fraction with CD144-PE antibody for sorting efficiency.
Centrifuge the five samples in FACS tubes for 5 minutes at 1'000 rpm (210g).
Resuspend each sample in 90 µl cold MACS-Buffer.
Keep the unstained control sample as is.
Add 10 µl IgG Isotypic control to the isotype control sample.
Add 10 µl CD144-PE antibody to the stained samples.
Incubate all labeled samples for at least 15 minutes at 4 °C.
Add 1 ml cold MACS-Buffer to each sample and centrifuge for 5 minutes at 1'000 rpm.
Resuspend all samples in 250 µl cold MACS-Buffer.
Samples are now ready for flow cytometry analysis.
Culture stem cell derived endothelial cells in StemPro34 + 50 ng/ml VEGF until they reach confluency (usually 3-5 days).
Cryopreserve the cells at a concentration of 1.5x10^6 cells per vial if not used immediately for further use.
Expand the differentiated endothelial cells for functional assays such as in vitro angiogenesis assay.
Use differentiated endothelial cells between passages 3 and 4 for consistent reproducible results.
Do not use cells after passage 5 when compared to primary cells like HUVECs.
